name: git
description: Git worktree, branching, and pull-request utilities: rebasing, atomic commits, syncing the default branch, and shipping a PR through CI.

interface.shortDescription: Git commit, rebase, and pull-request helpers.
interface.longDescription: Utilities for creating atomic commits, rebasing feature worktrees back onto the root repository branch, merging the default branch into a feature branch, and shipping a pull request through CI.
defaultPrompt: Use git:commit to create an atomic conventional commit for my current changes.
Use git:sync-main to merge the latest main into my current branch.
Use git:ship-pr to push this branch, open a PR, and merge it once CI is green.
Use git:release-ops to collect the ops checklist for the upcoming release.
